title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of ten lines. Start by drawing the first line from the origin to a point at (0.0155, 0.0). Continue with the second line to (0.0232, 0.0007), the third line to (0.0232, 0.0011), the fourth line to (0.0155, 0.0004), the fifth line to (0.0004, 0.0004), the sixth line to (0.0004, 0.0155), the seventh line to (0.0011, 0.0232), the eighth line to (0.0007, 0.0232), the ninth line to (0.0, 0.0155), and finally the tenth line back to the origin. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0232. Rotate and translate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translation vector as initially set. Extrude the sketch along the normal by 0.75 units to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object with a small rectangular protrusion at the top are: length of 0.02319587628865979 units, width of 0.02319587628865979 units, and height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch points
points = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.0155, 0.0),
    (0.0232, 0.0007),
    (0.0232, 0.0011),
    (0.0155, 0.0004),
    (0.0004, 0.0004),
    (0.0004, 0.0155),
    (0.0011, 0.0232),
    (0.0007, 0.0232),
    (0.0, 0.0155),
    (0.0, 0.0)
]

# Create the sketch
r = r.polyline(points).close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# L-shaped angle profile: overall 0.0232 x 0.0232, wall thickness ~0.0075
L = 0.0232
t = 0.0075

profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(L, 0.0)
    .lineTo(L, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, L)
    .lineTo(0.0, L)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.75)
)

r = profile
